grammar_title: 不定式作主语和表语(To have a balanced life is the best way…)
source: 上外版选择性必修三 Unit 1 Grammar in Use:Infinitives — used as subjects and predicatives。句子地道、围绕'应对压力'主题、答案唯一(主语/表语位置只接 to-V,有限动词或形式主语 it 唯一成立)。

points.point: 不定式作主语(To do ... is/takes ...)
points.overview: 句首主语位置不能放有限动词;表达'做某事'作主语时用不定式 To do(如 To have a balanced life is the best way to fight stress)。

points.point: it 作形式主语 + 真正主语不定式(It is ... to do ...)
points.overview: 为了句子平衡,常用 it 作形式主语,把真正主语不定式放句尾:It is important to stay calm。形式主语只能用 it;句尾真正主语用 to do。

points.point: 不定式作表语(主语 + be + to do ...)
points.overview: 系动词 be 后用不定式作表语,说明、解释或等同主语:My plan is to do some volunteer work;The best way to relax is to breathe slowly。

questions.stem: "____ a balanced life is the best way to fight stress."
questions.explanation: 句首主语位置不能用有限动词;'拥有平衡生活'作主语 → 不定式 To have。

questions.stem: "____ enough sleep every night helps you handle stress."
questions.explanation: 主语位置用不定式 To get,有限动词 get/gets/got 不能作主语。

questions.stem: "____ too much homework at once can make you anxious."
questions.explanation: '面对'作主语 → To face;其余为有限动词形式。

questions.stem: "____ slowly and deeply is a simple way to calm down."
questions.explanation: 主语为'缓慢深呼吸'→ 不定式 To breathe。

questions.stem: "____ about your worries with a friend often helps."
questions.explanation: '谈论'作主语 → To talk。

questions.stem: "____ healthy food is one great way to reduce stress."
questions.explanation: 主语位置用 To eat,不能用有限动词。

questions.stem: "____ time for fun keeps your mind fresh and calm."
questions.explanation: '留出时间'作主语 → To leave。

questions.stem: "____ regular exercise can lift your mood very quickly."
questions.explanation: 主语为'做运动'→ To do。

questions.stem: "____ that you feel stressed is the first useful step."
questions.explanation: '承认……'作主语 → To admit。

questions.stem: "____ your problems will never make them disappear."
questions.explanation: 主语为'忽视'→ To ignore。

questions.stem: "____ a trusted adult for advice is always a good idea."
questions.explanation: '询问'作主语 → To ask。

questions.stem: "____ soft music after class helps many students relax."
questions.explanation: 主语位置用不定式 To play。

questions.stem: "____ the early signs of stress can save you trouble."
questions.explanation: '注意到'作主语 → To notice。

questions.stem: "____ for a short walk often clears my busy mind."
questions.explanation: 主语为'去散步'→ To go,有限动词不能作主语。

questions.stem: "____ a journal every evening helps me feel calmer."
questions.explanation: '记日记'作主语 → To keep。

questions.stem: "____ kind to yourself really matters when life gets hard."
questions.explanation: 主语位置用不定式 To be。

questions.stem: "____ your feelings inside often makes the stress worse."
questions.explanation: '藏起'作主语 → To hide。

questions.stem: "____ a few breaks during study time can reduce stress."
questions.explanation: 主语为'休息几次'→ To take。

questions.stem: "____ a pet for a while can make you feel relaxed."
questions.explanation: '抱一会儿宠物'作主语 → To hold。

questions.stem: "____ what is bothering you is better than staying silent."
questions.explanation: 主语为'说出'→ To share。

questions.stem: "____ is important to stay calm before a big test."
questions.explanation: 形式主语只能用 it,真正主语是句尾的 to stay。

questions.stem: "____ is necessary to share your feelings with others."
questions.explanation: it 作形式主语指代后面的 to share。

questions.stem: "____ is helpful to recognise the real causes of your stress."
questions.explanation: 形式主语用 it,后接真正主语 to recognise。

questions.stem: "____ takes courage to admit that you feel stressed."
questions.explanation: It takes courage to do 固定结构,it 为形式主语。

questions.stem: "____ is normal to feel nervous before a performance."
questions.explanation: 形式主语 it + 真正主语 to feel。

questions.stem: "____ is hard to open up about your deepest worries."
questions.explanation: it 作形式主语,真正主语为 to open up。

questions.stem: "____ is wise to turn to an adult you really trust."
questions.explanation: 形式主语用 it,后接 to turn。

questions.stem: "____ feels good to talk about what is bothering you."
questions.explanation: it 作形式主语,真正主语 to talk 放句尾。

questions.stem: "____ is better to face a problem than to run from it."
questions.explanation: 形式主语 it 指代 to face。

questions.stem: "____ is worth taking some time to relax every single day."
questions.explanation: It is worth doing 中 it 为形式主语。

questions.stem: "It is wise ____ help when your worries last too long."
questions.explanation: 真正主语用不定式 to seek,放在形式主语 it 之后。

questions.stem: "It is important ____ enough sleep during exam week."
questions.explanation: 句尾真正主语用 to get。

questions.stem: "It is healthy ____ some exercise several times a week."
questions.explanation: 真正主语为 to do,有限动词不可用。

questions.stem: "It is useful ____ a few short breaks while studying."
questions.explanation: 形式主语 it 后的真正主语用 to take。

questions.stem: "It is not easy ____ calm when everything goes wrong."
questions.explanation: 真正主语用不定式 to stay。

questions.stem: "It is helpful ____ slowly and deeply when you panic."
questions.explanation: 句尾真正主语为 to breathe。

questions.stem: "It is brave ____ that you sometimes need a little help."
questions.explanation: 真正主语用 to admit。

questions.stem: "It is relaxing ____ to soft music after a long day."
questions.explanation: 形式主语 it 后真正主语用 to listen。

questions.stem: "It is smart ____ time for both study and play."
questions.explanation: 句尾真正主语为 to leave。

questions.stem: "It is good ____ your worries with someone you trust."
questions.explanation: 真正主语用不定式 to share。

questions.stem: "John's plan is ____ some volunteer work this weekend."
questions.explanation: be 后作表语,说明 plan 的内容 → 不定式 to do。

questions.stem: "The best way to relax is ____ slowly and deeply."
questions.explanation: 系动词 is 后用不定式作表语 to breathe。

questions.stem: "Her main goal is ____ those in trouble find a calmer mind."
questions.explanation: 表语用不定式 to help,说明 goal 的内容。

questions.stem: "My favourite way to unwind is ____ a long evening walk."
questions.explanation: be 后作表语 → to take。

questions.stem: "The very first step is ____ that you are feeling stressed."
questions.explanation: 系动词后表语用不定式 to admit。

questions.stem: "Our top priority is ____ the safety of every student."
questions.explanation: 表语用 to ensure,等同并说明 priority。

questions.stem: "His new habit is ____ to calm music before going to bed."
questions.explanation: be 后作表语 → to listen。

questions.stem: "The aim of the club is ____ teens deal with daily stress."
questions.explanation: 表语用不定式 to support。

questions.stem: "A wise choice is ____ enough sleep during exam week."
questions.explanation: 系动词后表语用 to get。

questions.stem: "What matters most is ____ a healthy, balanced life."
questions.explanation: be 后作表语 → to live。

questions.stem: "The mission of the centre is ____ people who feel low."
questions.explanation: 表语用不定式 to comfort,说明 mission。

questions.stem: "Her plan for the holiday is ____ yoga and read good books."
questions.explanation: be 后作表语 → to practise。

questions.stem: "The purpose of the talk is ____ what stress really is."
questions.explanation: 系动词后表语用 to explain。

questions.stem: "My only wish now is ____ a quiet and restful weekend."
questions.explanation: be 后作表语 → to enjoy。

questions.stem: "The best advice is ____ what worries you with a friend."
questions.explanation: 表语用不定式 to share。

questions.stem: "One good idea is ____ for a run whenever you feel tense."
questions.explanation: be 后作表语 → to go。

questions.stem: "The key to a calm mind is ____ time for rest and fun."
questions.explanation: 系动词后表语用 to leave。

questions.stem: "His main goal this term is ____ stress from taking over."
questions.explanation: 表语用不定式 to keep。

questions.stem: "A simple trick is ____ on one object until you feel calm."
questions.explanation: be 后作表语 → to focus。

questions.stem: "The best response to worry is ____ it instead of hiding it."
questions.explanation: 系动词后表语用不定式 to face。
